faqs.question: How do I adjust the light?
faqs.answer: Press the knob for power, turn to dim, and press and turn to change color temperature.

faqs.question: How long does it last on a charge?
faqs.answer: Up to 8 hours on a full charge, depending on brightness. NED lists a charging time of approximately 6 hours.

faqs.question: Can I use it outdoors?
faqs.answer: NED lists an IP65 rating and recommends bringing the lamp indoors after outdoor use.
